proof.text: Apply MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_id_right to the finite site. In the sequence-site case apply the same equality to the site component and the identity to the coefficient index. The equality-transport comparison followed by baseComp.hom is thus the restriction arrow specified by baseId.inv.

Evaluate pushComp.symm followed by transport on each module section, using the inverse composition section formula. Evaluate pushId by its forward section specification. Presheaf restriction functoriality and the preceding site equality identify the two transformations; extensionality gives the direct-image unit law.

Take the specified adjunction mates using Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_id_comp. Equality elimination shows that taking mates commutes with the endpoint equality transport. Evaluate the isomorphism equality at the module to obtain the required unit equation. All base and finiteness hypotheses of the public declaration are retained.

lean.statement: theorem ordinary_pullback_rightUnit (K : Scheme.{t}) (s : Option ℕ) : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (aX : X ⟶ K) (aY : Y ⟶ K) [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (_hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (M : Modules ell E Y s), (pull ell E f s).map ((identity ell E Y s).hom.app M) = (comp ell E f (𝟙 Y) s).hom.app M ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun a ↦ (pull ell E a s).obj M) (Category.comp_id f))
